messages:
morgan: Heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC role/permission refactor some internal tools are getting 403s when reading audit logs. Seeing `permission_denied: audit.logs.list` in the service logs. Anyone else hit this?

eva: yup saw that on staging this morning. The refactor renamed the old `logs.viewer` scope to `audit.read` but some services still request the old scope.

sam: reproducer: when using the SDK with service account X we get: `403 PermissionDenied: caller does not have permission audit.logs.list on project` — looks like the role binding didn't include the new permission.

morgan: here's the failing request from the edge proxy: `GET /v1/internal/audit?start=2026-03-18` header: `Authorization: Bearer svc-abc-xxx`

trent: quick workaround: add temporary role binding using `rbac:grant svc-account:svc-abc-xxx role:audit-reader` — that'll surface logs until we push the fix. Not ideal but buys time. :hourglass: 

security-bot: NOTE: creating temp bindings should be logged. Make sure to add ticket + expiry tag.

eva: I've opened PR #4852 — it updates SDK token scopes and server-side role mapping to accept both names during a migration window. Patch includes migration script `scripts/migrate-rbac-2026-03-19.sh`.

morgan: can you paste the migration script snippet? want to run on staging.

eva: sure — snippet:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# migrate role aliases -> canonical permissions
psql -h rds-readonly -U rbac -d rbacdb -c "UPDATE role_bindings SET permission = 'audit.read' WHERE permission = 'logs.viewer';"
# reload policy
curl -s -X POST "https://rbac-api.internal/_reload" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

sam: ran it on staging, reload worked. but prod requires careful timing with Dedicated infra.

trent: note on KMS: some service accounts use per-tenant KMS-wrapped keys and the key policy references the old role name. When we change role names we must update key IAM too or decrypt calls will 403.

morgan: good catch. which KMS policies are impacted?

eva: tenants: redwood-demo, partner-ops. I've filed KMS sync ticket and linked key ARNs in the PR.

sam: troubleshooting checklist I used: 1) check server logs for `permission_denied` 2) confirm token scopes with `jwks` introspect endpoint 3) verify role_binding table row for service account 4) check KMS key policy 5) add temp binding if needed.

morgan: can we get docs updated? People keep using old scope names in scripts. @docs-bot can you mark the API/SDK docs for an urgent patch?

docs-bot: Added task docs/urgent/rbac-scope-migration.md and flagged for devex review.

infra-bot: Deploy of rbac-service v2.18.1 queued. Change set includes role mapping fix and compatibility layer. ETA ~ 30m.

trent: also propose adding an auditable migration header in tokens so we can detect clients still requesting old scopes: `X-RW-Auth-Scopes-V1` — middleware will log and increment metric.

eva: added metric `rbac.old_scope_requests` in PR; dashboards will show per-service counts.

morgan: after deploy I'll run the KMS policy sync and then promote the migration script to prod in maintenance window.

sam: once prod is green, we should deprecate old scope name in SDKs with a one-week notice and a minor release that errors on old names.

trent: volunteering to coordinate rollout and runbooks. I'll draft incident runbook entry for access-control regressions.

morgan: thanks — assign to me and trent for runbook final review.

eva: prod deploy went green, infra-bot reported no errors, metrics show old scope requests dropping.

security-bot: RESOLVED? please ensure you attach audit trail links to the ticket.

morgan: closing the main ticket after adding audit links and KB entry. If anyone still sees 403s ping here. :slightly_smiling_face:
